title: Grilled Lamb Kebabs with Mediterranean Flair
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the richness of lamb with the bright, herby notes of Mediterranean cheese and herbs.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the lamb against the grain for tender bites

ingredients.name: Kefalograviera cheese, crumbled
ingredients.notes: This salty cheese is a key component of the Mediterranean flavor profile

ingredients.name: Fresh oregano, chopped
ingredients.notes: Don't be shy with the herbs - they add a lot of flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: Mediterranean olives, pitted
ingredients.notes: Choose a mix of green and black olives for added depth

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Don't overdo it on the garlic - it can overpower the other flavors

ingredients.name: Zest of 1 lemon
ingredients.notes: A squeeze of fresh lemon juice will brighten up the dish

ingredients.name: Grill seasoning
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality grill seasoning to add a smoky flavor

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (400°F).
In a large bowl, whisk together the oregano, lemon zest, garlic, and grill seasoning.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, crumble the Kefalograviera cheese into a bowl.
Once the lamb is cooked, brush it with a little olive oil and sprinkle with the crumbled cheese.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional oregano and olives if desired.
